Bottom row shows the same vehicle rendering from a lower perspective (left) and the photograph of the partially-assembled system in a laboratory (right). 4.2 Stabilization & Render Safe The stabilization & render safe of a R/N device occurs after such a device has been discovered. It concerns characterization of the device in the context of the surrounding environment, so that one may plan activities to reduce the threat of the device to public safety and first responders. In such a context, it is envisioned that SDF-related technologies could be used in approximate scene-setting, allowing for accurate estimates of dimensions and distances, especially in inaccessible of dangerous to access locations. In this new (potential) application area, SDF’s ability to be mounted on unmanned, autonomous ground or airborne vehicles is viewed as being among its most attractive features. This use-case would use an SDF-capable system’s lidar, GPS and a camera to image and record the device and its environments.
